name: howto
title: Fill a tire the right way
sub: NHTSA and AAA, five steps for any inflator
footer: Sources: NHTSA tire safety page; AAA "How to check tire pressure". Follow your inflator’s manual where it differs.

items.head: 1. Find the number
items.body: Door-jamb label or owner’s manual, not the tire sidewall.

items.head: 2. Check cold
items.body: Parked 3 hours or more; warm tires read 4–6 psi high.

items.head: 3. Preset and fill
items.body: Set the target psi, attach firmly, let it stop.

items.head: 4. Recheck by gauge
items.body: A stick gauge is the cross-check owners recommend.

items.head: 5. Do it monthly
items.body: AAA found warning lights come on at 20% low or worse.
